hints.title: Euclidean Distance Check
hints.text: For each tower, compute squared Euclidean distance to center: (x - cx)^2 + (y - cy)^2.

hints.title: Reachable Radius Filter
hints.text: Filter out any tower where squared distance exceeds radius^2.

hints.title: Score Maximization and Lexicographical Tie-breaking
hints.text: Compute score floor(quality / (1 + sqrt(dist_sq))). Find the tower with maximum score, breaking ties by lowest x then lowest y.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting all towers is unnecessary when a single pass tracks the optimal candidate.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects Euclidean distance calculation with tie-breaker logic.
